data.name: Forgesteed
data.description: Your mount has been reconstructed using some combination of minerals, metals, or crystal, and it is always in the form of a horse.  This mount does not eat, breathe, or sleep.  Should your mount die, you must spend one week in the process of creating and bonding with a new forgeborn mount.
